ruleDefinitions.name: File Download from Unknown Source with Wget Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: Linux External File Download via Wget

sequences.query:
activity_type:"process-create"
AND platform:"Unix"
AND process_name:"wget"
AND (additional_info:"http" OR additional_info:"https")
AND NOT additional_info:"metadata"
AND NOT additional_info:"computeMetadata"
AND NOT additional_info:"127.0.0.1"
AND NOT additional_info:"localhost"
AND NOT additional_info:"ubuntu.bigbluebutton.org"
